headline: Check Cruiser Rental and Mooring Availability
reservation: Cruisers are readily available for hire for those wishing to explore the Erne System. While entry to the waterway itself is generally open, visitors must verify rental requirements and specific mooring availability at individual islands through official waterway channels.

days.title: Exploring the Sheltered Waterways
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM from a local cruiser hire dock

stops.name: Upper Lough Erne
stops.detail: Navigate the tranquil and sheltered lake, which features a complex landscape of numerous islands and public moorings for exploration.

days.driving: Allow for slow-paced water travel; conditions vary by wind and weather.
days.note: A suggestion for a relaxed pace is recommended to enjoy the many moorings and sheltered nature of the lake.

intel.title: Mooring Access
intel.text: The lake features many moorings at various islands; however, availability is not guaranteed. Visitors should check the current status of specific public jetties before arrival.

intel.title: Connectivity Gap
intel.text: Evidence does not specify mobile signal strength on the lake. Boaters should carry appropriate navigation tools and verify coverage with local hire providers.

intel.title: Vessel Refueling
intel.text: Specific fuel locations for cruisers are not listed in provided sources. Ensure the vessel is fully fueled at the hire point and inquire about mid-lake supply options.

intel.title: Pacing the Lake
intel.text: Boaters are encouraged to explore the different parts of the waterway at their own pace. Allow ample time to navigate between the many islands safely.

intel.title: Waterway Navigation
intel.text: Access to the upper lough is primarily via cruiser. Ensure you are familiar with the sheltered nature of the system before navigating towards more open waters.

plan.arrival: Pick up your cruiser rental at a designated dock, complete a vessel safety briefing, and procure supplies at the nearest village before departing.
plan.vehicle: Cruisers are the primary mode of exploration here; check rental agreements for specific waterway restrictions.
plan.goldenHour: An island mooring at sunset provides a scenic view, though visibility for navigation decreases rapidly.
